items.t: Rocket Lab CEO Takes a Swipe at Elon Musk, Explains Why Neutron Gives Company an Edge Over SpaceX: ‘First Priority Is…’
items.sum: Rocket Lab CEO Peter Beck says Neutron could compete with Starship, while space services—not launches—offer a potential $1T market.

items.t: RKLB Stock Price Forecast: How Much Upside Do Analysts See Post-Q3 Earnings?
items.sum: U.S.-based aerospace company Rocket Lab USA (RKLB) reported an EPS loss of $0.12, missing analysts’ estimate of a $0.07 loss. However, revenue jumped 73% year-over-year to $268 million, beating the $257.21 million estimate. The company also posted a record $3.57 billion backlog, up 52% from the previous quarter. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy rating on RKLB, with an average price target of $95.35,
